CustomField.description: Stores the User who is the Solutions Engineer on this Opportunity's team (OpportunityTeamMember with Team Role = "Solutions Engineer"). System-stamped: set by the Opportunity Team widget (Opportunity_Team_Member_Manager) and the record-triggered flow Opportunity_Team_Member_Stamp_Role_Fields; cleared by the widget when that member is removed. Single-holder role. Deliberately kept off page layouts; used for reporting, filtering and list views.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Auto-populated from the Opportunity Team member with role "Solutions Engineer". Do not edit manually - add or remove the Solutions Engineer through the Opportunity Team widget.
CustomField.label: Solutions Engineer
